title: National Climate Change and Health Policy and Revised Action Plan - Marshall Islands
organization: Ministry of Health and Human Services, Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (MOHHS)
landscapes: Small Island Developing States, Tropical and Subtropical, Household, Institutional, Occupational, Athletics
description: This national climate change and health policy and revised action plan sets out priorities and actions to strengthen climate-resilient health systems in the Marshall Islands. It addresses climate-sensitive health risks including food and water safety, vector-borne diseases, non-communicable diseases, mental health and psychosocial well-being, respiratory diseases, and extreme weather events. The plan also includes heat-related preparedness strategies such as community heat education, rest and hydration guidance, shifting outdoor activities to cooler times of day, and reducing overheating in homes.
